global.title: Weekly ISS update: Joshua Kutryk aboard after record-fast docking
global.summary: Eleven people are living on the International Space Station after the SpaceX’s Crew-13 e arrived Oct. 1, among them Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Joshua Kutryk, on what the NASA called a record-setting 7-hour, 55-minute Dragon flight from Florida. SpaceX’s Crew-13 Dragon, named Grace, lifted off at 11:10 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and docked at 7:05 p.m. at the forward-facing port of the Harmony module, according to the NASA-SpaceX webcast .
